roles.name: System Architect
responsibilities: Scope, schemas, shared decisions, allocation, cross-domain integration, gates, final evaluation
roles.authority: Read-only regarding foxBMS implementation; full authority over corpus artifacts

roles.name: Functional Safety Engineer
responsibilities: Hazard analysis, safety goals, FSR/TSR, safety analyses (FMEA/FTA), safety case
roles.authority: Author of safety artifacts; reviewer of HW/SW safety requirements

roles.name: System Engineer
responsibilities: Stakeholder needs, system requirements, architecture, HSI, validation
roles.authority: Author of system artifacts; owner of HSI authority

roles.name: Hardware Engineer
responsibilities: HW requirements, architecture, detailed design, HW safety analysis, verification
roles.authority: Author of HW artifacts; reviewer of HSI

roles.name: Software Engineer
responsibilities: SW requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation mapping, unit verification
roles.authority: Author of SW artifacts; reviewer of HSI

roles.name: Verification Engineer
responsibilities: Verification measures, execution classification, trace coverage, evidence handling
roles.authority: Author of verification artifacts; reviewer of implementation

roles.name: Traceability/Data Engineer
responsibilities: Graph, schemas, exports, metrics, deterministic tooling
roles.authority: Owner of traceability infrastructure; reviewer of link consistency

roles.name: Domain Reviewer
responsibilities: Domain correctness, safety/standards mapping, provenance, verification quality
roles.authority: Reports findings; cannot modify artifacts directly

roles.name: Adversarial Reviewer
responsibilities: Challenge false completeness, unsupported source links, weak oracles, variant contamination, circular arguments, fake approvals, metric gaming
roles.authority: Reports findings; cannot modify artifacts directly

roles.name: Project Manager
responsibilities: Project plan, schedule, resources, milestones, risk management
roles.authority: Author of management artifacts; coordinates reviews

roles.name: Safety Manager
responsibilities: Safety plan, safety culture, escalation, confirmation measures
roles.authority: Author of safety management artifacts; approves safety case
roles.independence: Independent from technical authors per ISO 26262

review_policy.batch_review_rules: Only when all covered IDs/digests and findings enumerated
review_policy.ai_review_labeling: All AI reviews labeled with model, session, role; distinct from human approval
